content: {"like": ["Lynda Carter’s portrayal of Wonder Woman is the one I most identify with.", "Gal Gadot pulled off the role convincingly and is charming.", "The director’s specific vision and incredible planning are evident in the extraordinary level of detail.", "The film is more coherent than some big blockbuster Marvel outings, with well‑drawn central roles.", "The pace is brisk and includes a few humorous moments, such as the shopping scene at Selfridge’s.", "Robin Wright’s cameo as Aunt Antiope is enjoyable, even though she didn’t get more screen time.", "The climactic big battle delivers a satisfying conclusion despite the heavy CGI.", "Overall, the film is a pleasant surprise that brightens the DC Comics universe."],"dislike": ["The film’s climactic battle goes on and on and is an orgy of CGI effects, which some viewers find excessive.", "Some reviewers found the film too cheesy.", "There is a perceived lack of screen time for Aunt Antiope.", "Some negative comments focused on Gadot’s perceived inadequacies as an actress or her being too slight for the role.", "Greek mythology enthusiasts took umbrage with apparent inaccuracies in the script."]}
